title: Suspended illustration mobile
slide_intent: Give separate symbols a shared movement because related parts can feel connected without becoming identical.
strategic_value: The irregular hanging objects can express Mailchimp’s playful range while one yellow accent concentrates attention.
demonstration: A thin-line suspended mobile gently shifts its branches and hanging objects; a light-bulb shape flashes yellow.
practical_value: Compare subtle grouped motion with a localized color accent.

content_islands.name: Framework
content_islands.spec: Center the angular suspended structure on white.

content_islands.name: Objects
content_islands.spec: Hang varied objects at different heights and retain their small oscillations.

content_islands.name: Accent
content_islands.spec: Use the changing yellow bulb as the only strong color in the drawing.

reference_purposes.Expression: The loop combines lightly moving drawn objects with an intermittent yellow highlight.
